testCases.title: Competitive: Winner = Brand Name → all engines show Won in panel
steps: Given I am on the Competitive tab of a category where the tracked brand wins
When I find a row where the Winner column shows the brand name (Toyota)
Then the detail panel shows Won (green) badge for every active LLM engine

testCases.title: Competitive: Winner = Competitor Name → all engines show Lost in panel
steps: Given I am on the Competitive tab where a competitor brand wins
When I find a row where the Winner column shows a competitor brand name
Then the detail panel shows Lost (red) badge for every active LLM engine

testCases.title: Competitive: Winner = 'Lost' plain text → all engines show Lost in panel
steps: Given I am on the Competitive tab where the Winner column shows plain 'Lost' text (no badge border)
When I find a row where the Winner column shows plain 'Lost' text (span.text-slate-400.text-sm, no badge border)
Then the detail panel shows Lost (red) badge for every active LLM engine

testCases.title: Competitive: Winner = 'Split' badge → per-engine mix Won/Lost, Split never per-engine label
steps: Given I am on the Competitive tab where LLMs give different competitive results for the brand
When I find a row where the Winner column shows the orange 'Split' badge
Then each engine shows its individual badge (Won/Lost) — 'Split' never appears as a per-engine label
